_readme: Provenance manifest for every hardcoded real-world fact in this repo's calculators. Each entry names the real external source, its real update cadence, when it was last verified against that source (by whom/what commit), whether an automated check exists, and that check's actual verified status. Update this file in the same commit as any data fix. Do not add an entry with a fabricated or unverified source - if a fact's real source hasn't been checked, mark automated_check.status as "missing" and last_verified.method as "never independently verified", don't invent a plausible-looking entry.

entries.description: Per-city home price, property tax rate, and median household income for all 181 covered metros, feeding both the static city pages and (via lib/affordability-data.ts) the interactive calculator.

real_source.name: medianHomePrice/medianHouseholdIncome reused from networthrank's real Zillow ZHVI + HUD FY2026 Section 8 Income Limits audit (identical 181 city/state pairs); propertyTaxRate is a real state-level effective rate from Tax Foundation's 'Property Taxes by State and County, 2026' report
real_source.real_cadence: Zillow ZHVI monthly, HUD income limits annual (spring), Tax Foundation property tax table annual (though the underlying rate is a Census ACS 5-year estimate, so real-world year-to-year movement in the published rate itself is small and slow)

last_verified.method: manual audit - real Zillow/HUD figures reused directly from networthrank's already-verified city-data.ts (matched on (name, stateCode), not name alone, since 4 city names repeat across different states in this list); real Tax Foundation state property tax table downloaded and matched per state

automated_check.note: No workflow exists for this repo at all - this is the newest satellite to get a real-data pass and never had one built. Given this reuses networthrank's home price/income data, keeping this file in sync with networthrank's own future updates (not just re-checking Zillow/HUD independently) is the more direct freshness signal to watch for.

entries.description: Same real state-level property tax rates as the city-data.ts entry above, applied inside the interactive affordability calculator's own PITI math (previously a flat 1.1% national-average placeholder).

real_source.name: Tax Foundation, "Property Taxes by State and County, 2026" (2024 ACS 5-year estimate)
real_source.real_cadence: annual, though the underlying rate is a Census ACS 5-year estimate and moves slowly year to year

last_verified.method: manual audit - same real Tax Foundation table as the city-data.ts entry, duplicated into this file's own constant since it's a separate calculation path

automated_check.note: This table is a literal duplicate of city-data.ts's per-state rates. Worth de-duplicating into one shared source in a future pass so there's only one place to keep current, not two.
